# aigent-os

> Claude Code harness and alternative to context compaction: at 80% context it writes a verified capsule, runs /clear and resumes with persistent memory in git. MIT, local, Node 18+.

aigent-os replaces Claude Code auto-compact with Managed Auto-Refresh: capsule, exact acknowledgement, one /clear, fresh session check, resume. Memory is plain markdown in git. Public evidence is single-seat (11 of 11 cycles on one Windows seat); see Known limits in the v1.2.0 release notes.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-os/blob/master/README.md): what it does, install, evidence and limits, FAQ, alternatives
- [Getting started](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-os/blob/master/docs/getting-started.md): first install and session
- [Stop Claude Code auto-compact](https://wrg32786.github.io/aigent-os/questions/stop-claude-code-auto-compact.html): clear and resume instead of compacting
- [Claude Code auto clear](https://wrg32786.github.io/aigent-os/questions/claude-code-auto-clear.html): running /clear automatically at a context threshold
- [Long-running Claude Code sessions](https://wrg32786.github.io/aigent-os/questions/long-running-claude-code-sessions.html): keeping context across refreshes
- [Multiple Claude Code agents with persistent memory](https://wrg32786.github.io/aigent-os/questions/multiple-claude-code-agents-persistent-memory.html): seats, vaults and specialist sub-agents
- [aigent-os vs claude-mem and other memory tools](https://wrg32786.github.io/aigent-os/questions/aigent-os-vs-claude-mem.html): fair comparison from the README

## Plugin

- [context-capsule](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-os/blob/master/plugins/context-capsule/README.md): manual /capsule, /refresh and /resume as a plain Claude Code plugin
